# Composition demonstration assets

`webstore-blue-tshirt.jpg` is a 960px thumbnail of **Ironed blue T-shirt (001).JPG**, a photograph by **Juan de Vojníkov (Juandev)**, May 26, 2010. Source: [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ironed_blue_T-shirt_(001).JPG). Licensed [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). The source thumbnail is unmodified; composed demonstrations add the fictional logo. The photographic image and its composed derivatives, including the image portions of acceptance screenshots, retain CC BY-SA 3.0. No supplier affiliation, inventory, decoration capability or endorsement is claimed. UI/software around the photograph is separate from this image license.

`webstore-original-logo.png` is newly drawn fictional test artwork: transparent PNG, gold/white LINCOLN BOOSTERS text with a dark outline, rendered deterministically using Pillow. It is an original test input, not AI output or a real customer's artwork. It is supplied under CC0 for these demonstrations. Original bytes are retained during composition; only a resized copy is composited.

The browser workflow uploads these files through normal staff controls into its disposable private Webstore. Production templates receive no assets or fabricated placement/supplier data from these fixtures.
